meta.notes: A decorated pot pattern: asset_id names its picture, textures/entity/decorated_pot/wave_pottery_pattern.png (16 by 16), here a fish drawn by MSM on fired clay. A pot shows it on each side whose sherd carries the component minecraft:provides_pottery_pattern naming msm_examples:wave. Try /give @s minecraft:brick[minecraft:provides_pottery_pattern="msm_examples:wave"] and craft a decorated pot from four of it; the Pot pattern flow adds a recipe, a name and a picture for the sherd too.
